title: Quenched and Italian Eggs Bigoli
description: A classic Italian dish from Lombardy, featuring bigoli pasta, sake marinated eggs, and a smoky wine-infused sauce. This flexitarian-friendly recipe showcases the beauty of Italian cuisine.
instructions: Cook bigoli pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large saucepan, combine sake, dry white wine, vegetable broth, and garlic.
Bring mixture to a simmer over medium heat and cook for 5 minutes.
Add smoked mozzarella, smoked provolone, and grated grana padano cheese to the saucepan and stir until cheese is melted and sauce is smooth.
In a separate saucepan, melt butter over low heat and add lemon zest.
Add eggs to the saucepan with lemon zest and butter and cook until whites are set and yolks are still runny.
Slice cooked eggs in half and place on top of bigoli pasta.
Pour wine-infused cheese sauce over the eggs and pasta.
Sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
Garnish with additional lemon zest and grated cheese if desired.
